publication_rule: Only records with publish_ready=true should appear in the public event directory.
active_event_rule: status in [upcoming, recurring] and either end_datetime is in the future, or end_datetime is null and the local event date has not passed
expiration_rule: Events with a known end_datetime expire after that time. Events with an unknown end_datetime require review after the local event date and are then moved to ended/archive.

schema_notes.end_datetime_policy: end_datetime may be null when the organizer has not published an ending time. Such records require manual review after the event date and must not be assigned an invented ending time.
schema_notes.source_integrity_rule: Do not infer a street address, ending time, ticket link, or organizer URL that was not supported by the supplied source.

events.description: The Gainesville Police Department Citizens Police Academy gives members of the public a behind-the-scenes look at the department’s personnel, policies, and day-to-day operations. The free 30-hour program consists of one three-hour class each week for 10 weeks. Topics include communications and 911, patrol procedures, penal and traffic law, narcotics, gangs, criminal investigations, crime-scene investigation, demonstrations, tours, hands-on instruction, and an officer ride-along. Classes begin Thursday, August 6, 2026. The weekly meeting day and time have not been published, so applicants should contact the department for complete scheduling information. Applicants must be at least 18 years old and live or work in the Cooke County area. The extended application deadline is Thursday, July 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM.
events.cost_details: Free. Advance application and acceptance are required. Applications are due Thursday, July 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM.
events.age_restriction: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and live or work in the Cooke County area.
events.verification_note: Verified through the official City of Gainesville Citizen Police Academy page and the Gainesville Police Department announcement. The academy begins Thursday, August 6, 2026, and includes one three-hour class each week for 10 weeks. The weekly meeting time has not been published. Because start_datetime is required by the TWG schema, midnight is used only as a date placeholder and must not be presented as the actual class time. The newer police department announcement extends the application deadline to Thursday, July 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM, superseding the July 27 deadline still displayed on the city webpage. The program is free and open to adults age 18 or older who live or work in the Cooke County area. The supplied promotional image should be uploaded using the filename shown in image_url.
